summary: Backend testing of push notification URL format fixes. Verified: (1) send_push_to_user stores url in data.url of Expo payload, (2) twilio_webhooks.py active-conv push sends full URL (https://app.imonsocial.com/thread/{id}), (3) twilio_webhooks.py 'notify rep' push sends relative /thread/{id}, (4) ai_reply.py uses relative paths in ALL push calls, (5) _layout.tsx has router imported from expo-router AND URL stripping logic (new URL().pathname). All 14 tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: twilio_webhooks.py has TWO push calls for the same inbound SMS event — one at line ~485 (active-conv SMS throttle block, sends FULL URL) and one at line ~825 (notify-rep block, sends RELATIVE URL). The frontend URL stripping correctly handles both since full URL gets pathname extracted and relative URL passes through unchanged.

Inconsistency: The two push calls in twilio_webhooks.py use different URL formats (full vs relative). While the frontend fix handles both, it would be cleaner to standardize on relative paths in the backend. Low priority since frontend handles it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Push notification URL fix verified. twilio_webhooks.py line 485 sends full URL (app_url/thread/id) and line 829 sends relative /thread/id. ai_reply.py lines 150, 389, 703 all send relative /thread/. Frontend _layout.tsx imports router from expo-router and strips domain via new URL(url).pathname before router.push(). The fix is complete and consistent.
